To calculate $ P_{\text{extra}} $, use the formula:

$$
P_{\text{extra}} = C \cdot q^2
$$

Given:
- $ C = 0.012 \, \text{psi}/(\text{gpm})^2 $
- $ q = 340 \, \text{gpm} $

$$
P_{\text{extra}} = 0.012 \cdot (340)^2 = 0.012 \cdot 115600 = 1387.2 \, \text{psi}
$$

**Answer:** $ P_{\text{extra}} = 1387.2 \, \text{psi} $
